articulation.alt: doctor: /d/ → /ɑ/ → /k/ → /t/ → /ɚ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /d/: Tip touches the ridge; add voice and release.
/k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
